name: eqnonline-web
description: Client-side build for the eqn → LaTeX web app

scripts.build: cp -f node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css src/katex.min.css && cp -rf node_modules/katex/dist/fonts src/ && rollup -c && node scripts/add-banner.mjs
scripts.wheel: uv run python -c 'import pyroff.pyeqn' && uv build --wheel && rm -f dist/.gitignore
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run wheel && rm -rf release && mkdir -p release/src release/dist && cp index.html favicon.ico release/ && cp src/main.bundle.js src/main.css src/katex.min.css release/src/ && cp -r src/fonts release/src/ && cp dist/pyroff-*-py3-none-any.whl release/dist/
